# Rudder Docs

> Canonical public documentation for Rudder, generated from scripts/docs-content-map.yml.

Rudder gives humans and agents a shared place to move work from a goal to a reviewable result. Choose Chat for conversational work or an Issue when named ownership, dependencies, or a review path help.

## English

### Start here
- [Rudder](https://docs.rudderhq.dev): Rudder is open-source software for assigning, running, reviewing, and improving AI agent work across goals, Chat, issues, runs, budgets, workspaces, and feedback loops.

### Get started
- [Quick Start](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/get-started/installation): Install Rudder Desktop, confirm a healthy local startup, and recover safely when startup fails.
- [Create Your First Organization](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/get-started/first-organization): Complete one inspectable task with a request, Agent Run, output, and review decision.

### Concepts
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/overview): Follow one task through Rudder's organizations, work surfaces, agents, runs, outputs, and review.
- [Goals, Projects, And Issues](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/goals-projects-issues): How Rudder turns strategy into durable agent work.
- [Agents](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/agents): Understand Rudder agents as durable AI team members with roles, runtime configuration, capabilities, budgets, skills, and reporting boundaries.
- [Built-in Browser](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/built-in-browser): Understand Rudder Desktop's shared website session, Side Panel link behavior, and isolated agent browser control.
- [Issues](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/issues): Use an Issue when agent work needs durable status, ownership, dependencies, or a review path.
- [Chat and Messenger](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/chat-messenger): Choose Chat or an Issue for the task, then use Messenger to recover work needing human attention.
- [Calendar](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/calendar): Use Rudder Calendar to inspect AI agent run history, issue work, cost signals, and human checkpoints over time.
- [Workspaces](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/workspaces): Use Rudder workspaces to keep project Library files, agent-private files, skills, and runtime state in predictable locations.
- [Skills](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/skills): Use Rudder skills to package reusable operating instructions for repeated AI agent workflows and governed team learning.
- [Automations](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/automations): Use Rudder automations to run repeatable agent work from schedules, manual dispatch, APIs, or webhooks.
- [Reviews, feedback, and learning](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/reviews-feedback-learning): Use reviews and feedback to turn agent outputs into accepted work and better future runs.
- [Track approvals, budgets, and activity](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/approvals-budgets-activity): See how Rudder keeps decisions, spend, changes, run evidence, Dashboard health, Calendar history, and Inbox attention visible.
- [Plugins](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/plugins): Use Rudder plugins to add capabilities, jobs, webhooks, and UI surfaces without changing Rudder's core workflows.

### How-to guides
- [Run an issue from intake to done](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/issue-lifecycle): A practical Rudder guide for moving agent work from intake to backlog, todo, assignment, execution, review, evidence, and done.
- [Create an Agent](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/create-agent): Create a Rudder agent with a clear responsibility, role, runtime, capability boundary, skills, and review expectations.
- [Create an automation](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/create-automation): Create repeatable Rudder agent work with a trigger, owner, runtime context, and output path.
- [Review agent work](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/review-agent-work): Use Rudder reviews to inspect output, evidence, risks, and follow-up before closing agent work.
- [Manage Workspaces and Library](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/manage-workspaces-and-library): Keep project resources, Library files, durable outputs, backups, and run workspaces in the right Rudder locations.
- [Export and import an organization](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/export-import-organization): Move Rudder organization knowledge with previewable, scoped export and import steps.
- [Manage plugins](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/manage-plugins): Install, activate, inspect, update, and remove Rudder plugins while preserving core product rules and records.
- [Configure Feishu integration](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/configure-feishu-integration): Connect a Rudder agent to Feishu or Lark so teammates can talk to that agent from IM.
- [Configure Your Agent Runtime](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/configure-agent-runtime): Configure the local CLI, shell process, HTTP webhook, or gateway runtime Rudder uses when an AI agent heartbeat runs.

### Reference
- [Issue statuses](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/reference/issue-statuses): Reference the Rudder issue statuses used from intake to accepted work.
- [Runtime types](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/reference/runtime-types): Reference the agent runtime shapes Rudder can invoke and inspect.
- [Workspace boundaries](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/reference/workspace-boundaries): Reference where Rudder agents should read and write project files, Library files, private state, and scratch artifacts.
- [Automation output routing](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/reference/automation-output-routing): Choose whether a Rudder automation should create tracked issue work or send output to chat.
- [Permissions and platforms](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/reference/permissions-and-platforms): Understand local runtime file, credential, and platform boundaries for Rudder agents.

### Project
- [GDPval Harness Benchmark](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/benchmarks/gdpval-harness): Methodology and results from Rudder's 10-task GDPval-based harness pilot.
- [About Rudder](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/about): Learn what Rudder is, why it exists, and how it helps operators run AI agent teams through durable work loops.
- [Contact](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/contact): Find the right place to ask questions, report issues, request features, or follow Rudder development.
- [Changelog](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/releases): Stable Rudder release notes, upgrade notes, and GitHub Release links.

## 简体中文

### Start here
- [Rudder](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh): Rudder 为人和 Agent 提供一个共同工作空间，让任务从目标走向可检查、可评审的结果。

### Get started
- [快速开始](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/get-started/installation): 安装 Rudder Desktop，确认本地启动成功，并在启动失败时安全恢复。
- [创建第一个组织](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/get-started/first-organization): 完成一件可检查的任务，让请求、Agent 运行、产物和评审结论留在一起。

### Concepts
- [核心概念](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/overview): 通过一件任务理解 Rudder 中的组织、任务入口、Agent、运行记录、产物和评审。
- [目标、项目和任务](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/goals-projects-issues): 把策略变成能执行、能追踪的 agent 工作。
- [Agents](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/agents): Rudder 里的 agent 团队成员和执行方式。
- [内置浏览器](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/built-in-browser): 理解 Rudder Desktop 的共享网站会话、Side Panel 链接行为和隔离的 agent 浏览器控制。
- [Issue（任务单）](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/issues): 任务需要持久状态、明确负责人、依赖关系或评审流程时，使用 Issue。
- [Chat 和 Messenger](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/chat-messenger): 先为任务选择 Chat 或 Issue，再用 Messenger 找回需要人处理的工作。
- [Calendar](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/calendar): 按时间查看 agent 工作和人的检查点。
- [工作区](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/workspaces): 项目 Library 文件、agent 文件和运行时状态放在哪里。
- [技能](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/skills): 给 agent 复用的操作说明。
- [自动化](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/automations): 用 Rudder 自动化从定时任务、手动触发、API 或 webhook 运行可重复的 agent 工作。
- [Review、feedback 和 learning](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/reviews-feedback-learning): 用 review 和 feedback 判断 agent 输出，并把经验转成未来 run 可以使用的改进。
- [查看审批、预算和活动记录](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/approvals-budgets-activity): 理解 Rudder 如何让决策、预算、活动、运行证据、Dashboard、Calendar 和 Inbox 保持可见。
- [Plugins](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/plugins): 用 Rudder plugins 添加能力、jobs、webhooks 和 UI surface，同时保留核心工作流边界。

### How-to guides
- [如何把一条 issue 从请求跑到完成](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/how-to/issue-lifecycle): 用具体场景解释什么时候分配执行者、设置 reviewer、更新状态和关闭工作。
- [如何创建 Agent](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/how-to/create-agent): 在 Rudder 里新增一个职责清楚、能被 issue 调度的 agent。
- [创建自动化](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/how-to/create-automation): 创建带触发方式、owner、runtime context 和输出路径的可重复 Rudder agent 工作。
- [Review agent 工作](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/how-to/review-agent-work): 用 Rudder review 检查输出、证据、风险和 follow-up，再关闭 agent 工作。
- [管理 Workspaces 和 Library](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/how-to/manage-workspaces-and-library): 把项目资源、Library files、持久输出、backups 和 run workspaces 放在正确位置。
- [导出和导入组织](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/how-to/export-import-organization): 用可预览、范围明确的 export/import 移动 Rudder organization knowledge。
- [管理 plugins](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/how-to/manage-plugins): 安装、启用、检查、更新和移除 Rudder plugins，同时保留核心工作流边界。
- [配置飞书集成](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/how-to/configure-feishu-integration): 把 Rudder Agent 接入飞书或 Lark，让团队可以直接在 IM 里和 Agent 对话。
- [如何配置自己的 Agent Runtime](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/how-to/configure-agent-runtime): 把本地 Codex、Claude Code 或其他 coding agent 接入 Rudder。

### Reference
- [问题状态](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/reference/issue-statuses): 查看 Rudder 从 intake 到 accepted work 使用的 issue statuses。
- [运行时类型](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/reference/runtime-types): 查看 Rudder 可以调用和检查的 agent runtime 类型。
- [工作区边界](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/reference/workspace-boundaries): 查看 Rudder agents 应该在哪里读写项目文件、Library files、私有状态和临时产物。
- [自动化输出路由](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/reference/automation-output-routing): 选择 Rudder automation 应该创建 tracked issue，还是把输出发到 Chat。
- [权限与平台](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/reference/permissions-and-platforms): 理解 Rudder agents 的本地 runtime 文件、credentials 和平台边界。

### Project
- [GDPval Harness Benchmark](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/benchmarks/gdpval-harness): Rudder GDPval-based 10 任务 harness 探索性 pilot 的方法与结果。
- [更新日志](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/releases): Rudder 稳定版本的发布记录、升级说明和 GitHub Release 链接。
